description: This file provides utility functions for mapping statuses and strings to deterministic or themed colors, primarily used for visualizations in dashboards. It includes functions for generating consistent pastel colors from strings and mapping common status labels to specific theme colors.

methods.name: colorFromString
methods.description: Deterministically generates a pastel-like HSL color string from an input string, producing distinct hues for different strings while maintaining consistent saturation and lightness.

methods.name: getStatusColor
methods.description: Maps a given status string to a theme-specific color, with fallbacks to deterministic color generation for unknown statuses. Recognizes common status labels like 'processing', 'success', 'failed', and 'unknown'.
